description: This file defines the 'Antispam' model class for the Opencart admin system, providing methods to add, edit, delete, retrieve, and count antispam records in the database.
external_files: database connection and query classes/methods (implied by $this->db)

classes.name: Antispam
classes.description: Model class for managing antispam keywords in the database within the Opencart admin system.

methods.name: addAntispam
methods.description: Creates a new antispam record in the database with the provided keyword.

methods.name: editAntispam
methods.description: Updates an existing antispam record identified by its ID.

methods.name: deleteAntispam
methods.description: Deletes an antispam record from the database by ID.

methods.name: getAntispam
methods.description: Retrieves a specific antispam record by ID.

methods.name: getAntispams
methods.description: Retrieves multiple antispam records based on optional filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalAntispams
methods.description: Returns the total count of antispam records matching optional filters.
